from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0b4c234b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)]
    (r1, c1, _), (r2, c2, _) = sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[2])
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1 if r2 < r1 else 0
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1 if c2 < c1 else 0
    r, c = r1, c1
    while abs(r2-r) > 1 and abs(c2-c) > 1:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(r2-r) > 1:
        r += dr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(c2-c) > 1:
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task0b4c234b', p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; demo[3][11]=2; demo[10][1]=1
expected=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; expected[3][11]=2; expected[10][1]=1
for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]: expected[r][c]=3
print('demo matches',mod.transform(demo)==expected)
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
ans=mod.transform(test)
print(ans)
